summary: This Form 6-K reports a share capital amendment (reverse stock split followed by a forward split) and an anticipated filing of Form 15 to suspend SEC reporting obligations. The company consolidated shares 1-for-150 and then split 50-for-1, effectively reducing share count by a factor of three. Small shareholders (under 150 pre-consolidation shares) received $1.60 cash. The filing is a routine capital restructuring to reduce costs and administrative burdens, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or similar event is involved.
